comparison.objective: Select a sufficiently high-friction liner and stabilize a glass on an inclined rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Material-property selection, liner placement, and released-object stability management.
comparison.success_condition: Liner and glass correctly placed and released, with stability maintained for up to 20–25 s.
comparison.reason: Tests friction selection and passive stability rather than tool-mediated fracture and containment. Exact placement tolerances are not present, but the tested ability is clearly unrelated.
